scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB "npm run start:dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently -n API,DESKTOP "npm run start:dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w desktop"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n API,WEB,DESKTOP "npm run start:dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend" "npm run dev -w desktop"
scripts.setup: npm install && node backend/scripts/create-database.cjs && npm run prisma:generate -w backend && npm run db:push -w backend && npm run db:seed -w backend
scripts.db:update: npm run prisma:generate -w backend && npm run db:push -w backend
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w desktop
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.deploy:db: npm run db:deploy -w backend && npm run db:bootstrap -w backend
